notes.real_osm: bridges = OSM road x OSM canal crossings; churches/temples/cemeteries = OSM features in this tile; routes/power lines follow OSM canals/roads.
notes.procedural: everything else is placed by seeded rule, not observed; no prop depends on water states.
notes.rot: radians about +Y; local +Z = model front = (sin rot, cos rot); local +X = (cos rot, -sin rot)
notes.route_mode: pingpong = traverse back and forth along points
